basis: SHA-256 of data/OSF_REGISTRATION_P2SMD.json: the canonical OSF registration record (id, DOI, date_registered, template, title, description, registration_responses) as sorted compact UTF-8 JSON, rebuilt by scripts/osf_lock.py from the public OSF API
deviation: Planned basis was the OSF-issued registered PDF. The registration has no file attachments and no OSF-generated PDF, so the immutable registration record is hashed instead (main planner, 28 Nov 2026).
